scope: Resolve the invitee's relay list (kind 30051 d=marmot, else 10051) and use it for the KeyPackage lookup and the Welcome routing. Lookup and routing only, no new publication.
files_to_modify: app/src/lib/marmot/inviteeKeyPackageLookup.ts (pure parser + DI lookup; no pool side effects; verifies every event)
app/src/lib/marmot/relayRequest.ts (new: one-shot raw-WebSocket REQ with injected ctor; verifyRelayEvent)
app/src/context/MarmotContext.tsx (inviteByNpub delegates; real verifier; raw-socket listed requests)
app/src/lib/marmot/NdkNetworkAdapter.ts (getUserInboxRelays uses the verified parser; listed + effective)

behavior.relay_list: 30051 with d=marmot preferred over 10051; only events authored by the invitee; newest created_at; URLs from ['relay', url] tags; wss:// only (ws:// only for localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]); trimmed, scheme+host lowercased, trailing slash dropped, deduped, at most 3 in list order.
behavior.lookup: KeyPackages (443/30443) from the pool (started concurrently with the relay-list fetch) and from listed relays not covered by the pool/effective relays, each over its own raw WebSocket (REQ, collect until EOSE or 5 s, CLOSE, close; error = nothing, non-fatal; bound hit with nothing received = timedOut). NO NDK pool side effect. Every used event (relay lists and KeyPackages, pool and listed) is signature-verified through an injected verifier; listed-relay events must also be kind 443/30443 by the invitee. no_key_package only when nothing is found; timeout only when nothing found and a fetch timed out. Saved relay setting never written.
behavior.welcome_routing: getUserInboxRelays returns listed ∪ effective relays (listed first, deduped); effective relays alone on no list/timeout/error; never empty.

constraints: Only the KeyPackage REQ goes to listed relays; the relay-list REQ goes to the pool only
No profile data published or fetched (privacy invariant)
All other inviteByNpub steps and error codes unchanged
No UI text change expected (otherwise en + de in i18n.ts)
Parser is total (non-array tags, null elements, non-string values skipped)
Worst-case time to timeout with no listed relays is one pool timeout
No new dependency (nostr-tools already a direct dependency)
non_goals: Publishing kind 10051 or a relay-list pointer to default relays
Relay hints in the invite/pairing code (fully disjoint relay lists still cannot invite each other; OWNER question)
Changing what the app publishes (30051 to effective relays)
E2E specs (one-relay stack cannot produce the state)
remediation_round_1: Replaced NDKRelaySet + pool snapshot/cleanup by raw sockets (findings A, C), added signature verification and author/kind filtering (B), total parser (D), test and docs corrections (E, F).
remediation_round_2: covered relays = ndk.pool.permanentAndConnectedRelays() only; getUserInboxRelays keeps a verified list received before a timeout; normalised relay URLs keep the query (fragment dropped); lookup returns a usable pool KeyPackage without awaiting listed relays (abandoned flow never rejects); real-NDKEvent verifier test; docs corrected.
remediation_round_3: Coverage snapshot taken before the pool KeyPackage request; poolKey() tolerates NDK's slash after a query; docs wording (a)-(c).
